subject.title: Mac node approvals reject fractional usage timestamps

question: Should the protected maintainer-labeled Mac node approvals regression be fixed directly by a maintainer now, or should maintainers remove the protected label so automation can queue the narrow schema/test repair?
rationale: The bug and likely fix boundary are clear, but the live issue has the protected `maintainer` label, so this cleanup worker must pause instead of closing or auto-queuing repair work.

options.title: Patch the schema now
options.body: Accept finite non-negative numeric `lastUsedAt` values for file-backed exec approvals and add focused Gateway/protocol regression coverage.

options.title: Hand to automation after unprotecting
options.body: Remove the protected label and request a fresh ClawSweeper pass if maintainers want the narrow repair queued automatically.

options.title: Defer
options.body: Leaving current main unchanged keeps affected Mac node approval reads and safe allowlist updates blocked through the supported CLI path.

recommendation.title: Patch the schema now
recommendation.body: Accept finite non-negative numeric `lastUsedAt` values for file-backed exec approvals and add focused Gateway/protocol regression coverage.
